chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Musa ibn Umar ibn Bazi has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh—may Allah have mercy on him—from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Musa ibn Umar ibn Bazi.

key_terms.رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: may Allah have mercy on him; a supplicatory honorific for the deceased
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s own act of narration
key_terms.عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ: from Musa ibn Umar ibn Bazi; the named transmitter to whom the chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh to Mūsā ibn ʿUmar ibn Bazīʿ?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad for reports in the book traced through Mūsā ibn ʿUmar ibn Bazīʿ. It identifies the author’s transmission path through Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh, then ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, then his father, establishing the source chain for this material.
